generate_model_response.description: Send a prompt to a Cohere Command model and get back its written response.

mock_response.response_text: Here is a thoughtful response to your question about artificial intelligence and its applications in modern software development.

generate_model_response.name: generate_model_response

parameters.description: The message or question to send to Cohere.
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description: Which Cohere model to use. Defaults to command-a-plus-05-2026.
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: Maximum number of tokens Cohere may generate in its response. Raise it for longer replies. Leave blank to use the model's own maximum output length.
parameters.name: max_tokens

model.description: The Cohere model that produced the response.

response_text.description: The text that Cohere generated for your prompt.

description: Connect Cohere's Command models to answer questions, write text, and generate content in your workflows.
